home.heroText: A regional youth-led organization bringing together young people working at the intersection of agriculture, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship and sustainability across East Africa.
home.whyText: Africa’s agricultural future depends on technology, data, climate-smart systems and youth leadership. Young people are already building solutions, yet many remain disconnected from funding, policy spaces and regional networks. We bridge that gap by amplifying the collective voice of agritech youth.
home.ctaText: Founders, developers, students, researchers, farmers: there is a place for you.

about.intro: A regional youth-led organization at the intersection of agriculture, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship and sustainability.

aboutCards.title: Our vision
aboutCards.text: A unified, influential and inclusive agritech youth movement driving food systems transformation, digital agriculture and sustainable development across Africa.

aboutCards.title: Our mission
aboutCards.text: To empower and connect young people through collaboration, policy engagement, capacity building, entrepreneurship support and regional partnerships.

aboutCards.title: Our approach
aboutCards.text: Collaborative, action-oriented and youth-driven. Members are contributors, leaders and change-makers, not just participants.
